description: This file defines the DebugSettings SwiftUI View, providing a comprehensive user interface for debugging and diagnostic tools within a macOS application. It includes sections for application info, gateway management, logs, port diagnostics, file paths, quick actions, and canvas interactions. The code also contains helper methods for performing actions like checking ports, resetting tunnels, managing session paths, and evaluating or capturing canvas content.

classes.name: PlainSettingsGroupBoxStyle
classes.description: A custom style for grouping boxes in the settings UI with specific layout and style.

methods.name: runPortCheck
methods.description: Asynchronously runs a port check to report port status and listeners.

methods.name: resetGatewayTunnel
methods.description: Asynchronously resets the SSH tunnel used for the gateway and rechecks ports.

methods.name: requestKill
methods.description: Requests to kill a port listener; if expected, prompts confirmation, otherwise kills immediately.

methods.name: killConfirmed
methods.description: Confirms and executes a process kill by PID, then updates port status.

methods.name: chooseCatalogFile
methods.description: Opens a file dialog to select a model catalog file, then triggers reload.

methods.name: reloadModels
methods.description: Asynchronously loads models from the catalog path, updating state based on success or failure.

methods.name: sendVoiceDebug
methods.description: Asynchronously sends a debug voice message and updates UI with status.

methods.name: revealApp
methods.description: Reveals the app bundle in Finder.

methods.name: saveRelayRoot
methods.description: Saves the gateway project root path to manage environment setup.

methods.name: loadSessionStorePath
methods.description: Loads the session store path from configuration and updates state.

methods.name: saveSessionStorePath
methods.description: Saves the current session store path into the configuration JSON.

methods.name: canvasPresent
methods.description: Displays a specified session in the Canvas web view.

methods.name: canvasWriteSamplePage
methods.description: Creates and writes a sample HTML page to the session directory for Canvas debugging.

methods.name: canvasEval
methods.description: Evaluates JavaScript in the Canvas session and displays the result.

methods.name: canvasSnapshot
methods.description: Captures a snapshot of the Canvas session and provides the file path.
